primary_sources.role: classical transformation and viscous Burgers analysis
primary_sources.title: The partial differential equation u_t + u u_x = mu u_xx
On a quasi-linear parabolic equation occurring in aerodynamics

route_a.qualification: the positive projective heat lift is a source PDE linearization with no intrinsic rational-prime carrier, periodic-orbit divisor, target analytic structure, or Hilbert--Polya semantics

theorem.algebraic_snapshot_oracle: rational (rho,zeta) rows probe the universal two-parameter heat/translation multiplier; the physical one-parameter curve rho=exp(-nu*t), zeta=exp(-i*m*t) is included analytically, but a rational sentinel need not lie on that curve
theorem.asymptotic_exponent: nu*(2*pi*r/L)^2 for the first nonzero Fourier mode r of the positive Cole-Hopf representative
theorem.linearized_spectrum: lambda_k=-nu*(2*pi*k/L)^2-i*m*(2*pi*k/L), k in Z; omit k=0 on X_m^s
theorem.phase_leaf: X_m^s={u in H^s(T_L;R):mean(u)=m}, s>3/2, nu>0, L>0
theorem.recurrence: the only equilibrium, periodic point, or recurrent point on X_m^s is u identically m
